2608.01328.title: LongChart VQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLMs with Complex Multi-Chart Reasoning
2608.01328.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving with expanded context windows and stronger reasoning capabilities, enabling multi-chart understanding and multi-step inference. These abilities are increasingly important as MLLMs are adopted in complex agentic tasks. However, existing benchmarks largely emphasize single-chart perception, while simple chart-to-chart connections are insufficient to evaluate these capabilities. To capture multi-chart complexity while ensuring consistency and validity, we design a synthesis pipeline supported by latent graphs. Building on this pipeline, we introduce LongChart, a benchmark whose VQA sets contain an average of 6.5 images and 31.2 questions. We evaluate 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs and examine three factors that influence performance: reasoning patterns, auxiliary tools, and robustness to image perturbations. Our results show that MLLM accuracy decreases and varies substantially as computational complexity increases, highlighting directions for future research in multi-chart reasoning.
2608.01328.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）正在迅速發展，擴展的上下文窗口和更強的推理能力使得多圖理解和多步推理成為可能。隨著MLLMs在複雜的代理任務中被採用，這些能力變得越來越重要。然而，現有的基準主要強調單圖感知，而簡單的圖對圖連接不足以評估這些能力。為了捕捉多圖的複雜性，同時確保一致性和有效性，我們設計了一個由潛在圖支持的合成管道。在此管道的基礎上，我們引入了LongChart，一個基準，其VQA集平均包含6.5張圖片和31.2個問題。我們評估了10個最先進的MLLMs，並檢查了影響性能的三個因素：推理模式、輔助工具和對圖像擾動的穩健性。我們的結果顯示，隨著計算複雜性的增加，MLLM的準確性下降並顯著變化，突顯了未來多圖推理研究的方向。
